name: r4-full-resource-placement
budget_rationale: Complete eight-round Shor source and complete R3/R5 declared carrier inventory, no physical-stage truncation. One SA placer uses 1000 x 400 moves plus 100 initial moves, enforced 600-second search wall budget; 1200 seconds includes pinned environment setup and source/output verification. Prior 5-patch observed placement cost was under 90 seconds; 12-patch budget expanded with 8 GiB sampled tree RSS, not all shared-server resources. This stage is inventory and placement only, not a full Shor physical run.
